description: An invariant reading a constant (`L`) whose initializer reads a constant only server code reads (`K`): E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE (checking the invariant in the client would print `K` there). The set refused through a constant is the set refused directly.
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-const-read: "A `let`, a host-derived const, or a server-only const stays refused." §66.13.5 rule 7a: what is server-only without the invariant and held by the client with it is refused.
